decisions_applied: D34 working state + immutable checkpoints: update/restore return DocumentSnapshot of the working state

changed_behaviour: documents: new Operations\DocumentOperations / CommentOperations reached through Documents::in($drive) / Documents::comments($drive) (DriveHandle::extension); every method runs NodeLocator (active, drive-scoped, tenant boundary) + OperationGuard + ProfilePolicy.
documents: Actions take execute(OperationContext, *Input); actor id comes from the context (no ambient auth, no actorId in inputs).

documents: new snapshot DTOs Data\Snapshots\{DocumentSnapshot,DocumentRevisionSnapshot,CommentSnapshot} + internal mapper; Queries\DocumentQuery (revisions cursor created_at DESC,id DESC; comments oldest-first; revision/comment strictly inside the node).

documents HTTP: DocumentNodeController, NodeCommentController, NodeCollaborationController::token call only Operations; same URLs and JSON keys; ids in JSON become strings (D38); a node without View answers 404 node_not_found (was 403); export requires Download (was View); comment resolve = Comment AND (author OR Edit) (was author OR Manage); trashed nodes answer 404 node_not_found from NodeLocator (was abort(404)).

documents collaboration: CollaborationSessionService::issue(Node, Ability, actorId) no longer resolves access itself; DocumentOperations::collaborationSession authorizes View and passes Edit/Comment/View. Hub endpoints authenticate/store keep their behaviour; their node lookup and persistence move behind the internal Collaboration\CollaborationHub service so the controller imports no Action/Repository.
